profile.headline: Software Developer II for Real Time Automation at MWI Animal Health
profile.summary: Experienced automation technician with a demonstrated history of working in the cattle production industry. Skilled in programmable logic controllers, electrical wiring AC/DC, Microsoft office, computer networking, and experience with Linux and Windows operating systems. Proven experience with customer service, farms, animal nutrition, machinery, and the agriculture industry. Systems testing and quality assurance experience for hardware and software that goes into installations. Strong operations professional with leadership experience from mentoring employees from initial hire.

educations.schoolName: US Dairy Education and Training Consortium Session 2
